concept.title: Troubleshooting Clair issue
concept.shortdesc: To troubleshoot Clair vulnerability scanning in Red Hat Quay and resolve scan issues, you can verify image compatibility, allowlist Clair updaters when using a proxy, check the Clair config.yaml, and inspect image metadata.

section.title: Verifying image compatibility
section.p: If you are using Clair, ensure that Clair supports the images you are trying to scan. Clair has certain requirements and does not support all image formats or configurations.

section.title: Allowlisting Clair updaters
section.p: If you are using Clair behind a proxy configuration, you must allowlist the updaters in your proxy or firewall configuration.

section.title: Checking Clair configuration
section.p: Check your Clair config.yaml file to ensure that no misconfigurations or inconsistencies could lead to issues.

section.title: Inspect image metadata
section.p: In some cases, you might receive an Unsupported message. This might indicate that the scanner is unable to extract the necessary metadata from the image. Check if the image metadata is properly formatted and accessible.
